tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are planning a trip with your classmates to a popular tourist destination during your semester break. You need to book accommodations and ensure the hotel can meet your group's needs. Write an email to the hotel manager, Mr. Carter.
bullets: Explain the purpose of your trip and the number of people in your group.
Request the hotel send any additional information needed.
tasks.subject: Class Trip Accommodation Inquiry
